early.label: Early recovery
early.headline: Early recovery stage
items: Scabs may form and itching can occur.
Do not pick at scabs, and apply moisturizer generously.

middle.label: Mid recovery
middle.headline: Mid recovery stage
items: Scabs may form and itching can occur.
Do not pick at scabs, and apply moisturizer generously.
Gentle washing with water is allowed.

stable.label: Stable recovery
stable.headline: Stable recovery stage
items: Scabs may form and itching can occur.
Do not pick at scabs, and apply moisturizer generously.

report.label: Medical document
report.title: Emergency medical report
report.description: An English medical summary to show local clinicians in an emergency.

alert.title: Contact your clinic immediately
items: A fever of 38.5°C or higher that does not subside
Unusual bleeding or discharge at the treated area, or pain that suddenly worsens

notice.title: Please note
items: This guidance is not a medical diagnosis or prescription.
If symptoms worsen or warning signs appear, contact your clinic or emergency services immediately.
